about.title: About Agios App
about.tagline: "Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path" (Ps 119:105)

story.title: Story & Goal
story.p1: The Agios project was launched with a vision to provide a sophisticated digital experience for Bible study. It started through participation in the St. Mark's Preaching Festival in Alexandria, where the project sought to provide innovative technical solutions, such as advanced linguistic search, interactive maps of holy places, and a modern user interface that helps with focus and spiritual growth.
story.p2: After success in its early stages, work continued on developing the platform to become a comprehensive reference that combines daily study tools and modern technical features, serving the needs of youth and students in the digital age.

developer.title: About the Developer
developer.desc: Agios System was developed by Manuel Georges, a software developer specialized in building innovative web and mobile applications to serve the Church.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.desc: The vision of Agios is to be a technical bridge connecting generations to the Word of God, using modern tools to present biblical content in an attractive and simplified way, while fully adhering to the foundations of the sound Orthodox faith and the traditions of the universal church.

thanks.title: Acknowledgements
thanks.priest_desc: We extend our deepest gratitude and love to {name} for his constant fatherly care for this work since its first moments, and for adopting the idea and supporting it to come out in a form worthy of the Word of God and be a blessing and benefit to all its users.
thanks.priest_abraam_desc: We extend our special appreciation and deep gratitude to {name} (General Vicar of the Patriarchate in Alexandria) for his great paternal support for the application in its early launch stages, and his effective assistance in publishing, funding, and providing all material and moral opportunities for the success of this work.
thanks.fcbh: Special thanks to Faith Comes By Hearing for providing the wonderful audio library by Mr. Adel Noshy, and for their continuous technical support that contributed to enriching the user's listening experience in this app.
thanks.church: We express our gratitude and appreciation to our home church, Archangel Michael Church in Mostafa Kamel - Alexandria, for the constant support and encouragement, and to the St. Mark's Preaching Festival committee that provides opportunities for creativity and innovation in the service of the church and society.
thanks.translations: The Smith & Van Dyke translation is used for Arabic, the World English Bible for English, the Louis Segond translation for French, and the Luther translation for German. All of these translations are open-source and legally permitted for use.
thanks.general: Special thanks to everyone who contributed by providing technical or spiritual advice, and to everyone who participated in spreading this work for the blessing to prevail. We ask God to make this application a cause for a deeper reading and understanding of His life-giving word.

history.title: Audio & AI Enhancements and UI Fixes

Enhanced response and reliability of AI features in search and analysis
fixes: Fixed an issue where some AI features stopped working
Fixed duplicate back button issue on Analysis and Widgets pages

history.title: Widgets Support & Performance Overhaul
features: Added Home Screen Widgets (Daily Verse, Daily Question, My Points, Study Plan)
Significantly improved app performance for a faster experience
Simplified UI navigation and interaction
Improved data synchronization between the app and widgets
fixes: General technical fixes and better battery consumption

history.title: Critical Fixes, Language Support & Dev Links
features: Added App Store, Google Play and Developer links in 'About' page
Enabled French language support in Bible Maps
fixes: Fixed AI Analysis page crashing issue
Fixed app crashing when French language is selected
General system stability improvements

Simplified the search experience so it is easier for more people to use
Improved the design of both the Bible and search pages
Simplified overall verse interaction experience
fixes: Fixed the issue where verse images were not sharing correctly on iPhone devices
Resolved the reference issue when sharing multiple verses

Enhanced verse selection and copy flow
Major improvements to the daily question experience
Simplified verse analysis presentation
fixes: Fixed the issue that prevented maps from working
Fixed verse selection and copying bugs

Fixed favorite verse color mismatch between search and Bible pages
Fixed issue with daily verse image not saving correctly for iPhone users

Added support for 3 new languages (English, French, German) with core features
Improved Arabic text display and formatting in the Holy Bible
Design improvements and better responsiveness for small screens
Enhanced user experience and homepage development
fixes: General performance improvements and system stability
